title: Final Formula Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct derivation of the formula for W must be shown.

title: Black Body Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The calculation of W for black bodies at given temperatures must be correctly performed.

title: General Case for n Plates
description: Important Criteria: The derivation for W with n identical black body plates must be correctly established.

title: Use of Stefan-Boltzmann Law
description: Important Criteria: The application of the Stefan-Boltzmann law in calculations must be correctly applied.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign errors in the final expressions must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors in the equations derived must be checked.
